settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about keys, billing, and what moving to RelayHub actually takes.

items.question: How is RelayHub different from a directory of APIs?
items.answer: A directory just links you to vendors. RelayHub is a real marketplace: one key authenticates every API, one bill covers them all, and every listing is vetted for reliability and honest pricing.

items.question: Do I have to migrate my existing integrations?
items.answer: No. You can keep using your current providers and add RelayHub for new ones. When you're ready, our migration guide walks you through moving existing keys over in an afternoon.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: You're billed monthly for the API usage you actually consumed, all on one invoice. There's no platform markup on most listings, and you can set spend caps to stay in control.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. RelayHub is SOC 2 Type II certified, and your API keys are encrypted at rest and in transit. We never see the payloads flowing between you and the providers you use.

items.question: Can my whole team use one account?
items.answer: Yes. Pro and Scale plans support team keys with granular roles, so each developer gets their own key while you keep a single bill and a single audit trail.
